# Release checklist

## Release

Version: `x.y.z`

## Branches

- [ ] Feature branches merged into `develop`
- [ ] Release branch created from `develop`
- [ ] Final release branch merged into `main`

## Documentation

- [ ] README updated
- [ ] ROADMAP updated
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Developer notes updated if needed

## Manual tests

- [ ] Project creation
- [ ] POI creation, edit, delete
- [ ] Route creation
- [ ] Import `.wmap`
- [ ] Export `.wmap`
- [ ] GPX import/export
- [ ] KML import/export
- [ ] CSV import/export
- [ ] Elementor frontend rendering

## Packaging

- [ ] Version header aligned
- [ ] `SWM_VERSION` aligned
- [ ] ZIP build generated
- [ ] Release tag created

## Notes

Add known limitations or follow-up issues here.
